new.n: 'King Strang's buried treasure' legend, Holy Island, Lake Charlevoix
new.pl: Holy Island in Lake Charlevoix (Pine Lake), said to hold the site of the old Mormon fort and an Ottawa war post
new.st: In 1912 a promoter selling lots on Holy Island advertised a free 'Illustrated History of Holy Island and King Strang's Buried Treasure'. The same page said the island held the site of the old Mormon fort and an old Ottawa war post. This is the earliest printed local mention of the tradition found so far, but it is a sales tie-in, not evidence. No find is known.
new.t: Small island, now private residential lots: look only unless an owner invites you. The 1912 booklet, if a copy survives, may name the claimed spot.
src: Charlevoix County Herald, 17 Aug 1912, p. 1 (Chronicling America; lot-auction ad and news item; PC (b))
new.warn: Private island lots: look only; permission.
pinev: GNIS Holy Island, Charlevoix Co; the legend names the island, not a spot
new.tovw: Lead grade D (treasure thread): one promotional source, legend names only the island
